appearance_facts.fact: Title reads 'Top Regions: Ad Spend vs Sales'. The plot area is a scatter plot with five labeled points (Region A through Region E) arranged in an upward-sloping pattern from bottom-left to top-right.

The vertical axis is labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)' with tick marks from 50 to 180 in increments of 10. The horizontal axis is labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' with tick marks from 25 to 75 in increments of 5.
The point labeled 'Region A' is located at approximately x=30, y=58. It is the lowest point on the chart.
The point labeled 'Region B' is located at approximately x=35, y=65. It is positioned above and to the right of Region A.
The point labeled 'Region C' is located at approximately x=42, y=81. It is positioned above and to the right of Region B.
The point labeled 'Region D' is located at approximately x=48, y=92. It is positioned above and to the right of Region C.
The point labeled 'Region E' is located at approximately x=70, y=173. It is the highest and rightmost point on the chart, showing a significantly larger gap in sales compared to the other regions.
